import json
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, LabelEncoder
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
with open("./input/train/train.json", "r") as f:
    train_data = json.load(f)
with open("./input/test/test.json", "r") as f:
    test_data = json.load(f)

# Convert to DataFrames
train_df = pd.DataFrame(train_data)
test_df = pd.DataFrame(test_data)

# Extract text features
text_cols = ["request_title", "request_text_edit_aware"]
for col in text_cols:
    train_df[col] = train_df[col].fillna("")
    test_df[col] = test_df[col].fillna("")

# TF-IDF features
tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=500, stop_words="english", ngram_range=(1, 2))
tfidf.fit(train_df["request_title"] + " " + train_df["request_text_edit_aware"])

X_train_text = tfidf.transform(
    train_df["request_title"] + " " + train_df["request_text_edit_aware"]
)
X_test_text = tfidf.transform(
    test_df["request_title"] + " " + test_df["request_text_edit_aware"]
)

# Numeric features
numeric_features = [
    "requester_account_age_in_days_at_request",
    "requester_days_since_first_post_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_in_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_subreddits_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_minus_downvotes_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request",
    "unix_timestamp_of_request_utc",
]

# Handle missing values
for col in numeric_features:
    if col in train_df.columns:
        train_df[col] = train_df[col].fillna(train_df[col].median())
        test_df[col] = test_df[col].fillna(train_df[col].median())

X_train_num = train_df[numeric_features].values
X_test_num = test_df[numeric_features].values

# Subreddit count feature (number of subreddits)
train_df["subreddit_count"] = train_df["requester_subreddits_at_request"].apply(
    lambda x: len(x) if isinstance(x, list) else 0
)
test_df["subreddit_count"] = test_df["requester_subreddits_at_request"].apply(
    lambda x: len(x) if isinstance(x, list) else 0
)

# Timestamp-based features
train_df["request_hour"] = pd.to_datetime(
    train_df["unix_timestamp_of_request_utc"], unit="s"
).dt.hour
train_df["request_dayofweek"] = pd.to_datetime(
    train_df["unix_timestamp_of_request_utc"], unit="s"
).dt.dayofweek
test_df["request_hour"] = pd.to_datetime(
    test_df["unix_timestamp_of_request_utc"], unit="s"
).dt.hour
test_df["request_dayofweek"] = pd.to_datetime(
    test_df["unix_timestamp_of_request_utc"], unit="s"
).dt.dayofweek

# Merge features
X_train = np.hstack(
    [
        X_train_num,
        train_df[["subreddit_count", "request_hour", "request_dayofweek"]].values,
    ]
)
X_test = np.hstack(
    [
        X_test_num,
        test_df[["subreddit_count", "request_hour", "request_dayofweek"]].values,
    ]
)

# Combine with text features
from scipy.sparse import hstack

X_train = hstack([X_train_text, X_train])
X_test = hstack([X_test_text, X_test])

# Labels
y_train = train_df["requester_received_pizza"].values

# Train/validation split (stratified)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, stratify=y_train, random_state=42
)

# Convert sparse to dense for LightGBM (with warning suppressed)
X_tr_dense = X_tr.toarray()
X_val_dense = X_val.toarray()
X_test_dense = X_test.toarray()

# LightGBM model
lgb_train = lgb.Dataset(X_tr_dense, label=y_tr)
lgb_val = lgb.Dataset(X_val_dense, label=y_val, reference=lgb_train)

params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
}

model = lgb.train(
    params,
    lgb_train,
    num_boost_round=500,
    valid_sets=[lgb_val],
    callbacks=[
        lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False),
        lgb.log_evaluation(period=0),
    ],
)

# Validate
val_preds = model.predict(X_val_dense, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds)
print(f"Validation AUC: {auc:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
test_preds = model.predict(X_test_dense, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)

# Create submission
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {"request_id": test_df["request_id"], "requester_received_pizza": test_preds}
)

# Save submission
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
